findings.source_quote:
The Call to Discipleship

...Discipleship is incumbent on the believer. ... Discipleship will lead us into a total abandonment of ourselves to Christ.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the standard, widely accepted Indonesian theological term for “discipleship” (pemuridan) instead of the uncommon/neologism “kepelatihan.” Replace instances of “Kepelatihan” with “Pemuridan” (preserve HTML tags and order). This keeps theological meaning and idiom intact.
findings.translation_quote:
Panggilan untuk Kepelatihan

...Kepelatihan adalah kewajiban bagi orang percaya. ... Kepelatihan akan membawa kita ke dalam penyerahan diri total kepada Kristus.

findings.location: paragraph containing: "Maaﬁkan orang yang telah menyinggungmu."
findings.source_quote: Then “Love your neighbor” – “Serve the needy” – “Defer to your brother” – “Forgive the one that has offended you”.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the typographic/encoding error in the Indonesian verb for “forgive.” Replace “Maaﬁkan” (contains a ligature or incorrect character) with the standard Indonesian spelling “Maafkan.” Preserve surrounding punctuation and HTML tags.
findings.translation_quote: Lalu "Kasihilah sesamamu" – "Layani mereka yang membutuhkan" – "Utamakan saudaramu" – "Maaﬁkan orang yang telah menyinggungmu."
